translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l027: Суп has ordinary cotton and epic fine white silk/camel-wool senses; chooses epic cloth without asserting the fibre. https://el-sozduk.kg/суп/ Yudakhin I.2.
notes.manas-2010:p1679:b001:l012: Printed Бөлүнө retained; provisional distributive reading from бөлүн-, rather than silently emending to белине (his waist). Exact formula needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p1679:b001:l013: Жааны read as rain beside жамгыр, preserving synonymous repetition rather than making the second term bows.
notes.manas-2010:p1680:b001:l020: Үч айча мурун means about three months earlier than Almambet, not three months longer in duration.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l021: Санжыргалуу denotes an authoritative/illustrious hero in established project lexicon; does not assert good fortune at his impending death.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l013: Каргылуу figurative strong/reliable/protective sense; spatial earth as shelter provisional, not merely cherished. https://el-sozduk.kg/каргылуу/ Yudakhin2, protective mountain metaphor.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l018: Кан ыйлап read as blood-weeping formula beside калайык ыйлап; not a newly introduced khan subject.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l007: Ычкыры түпөк төрт муундун: түпөк decorative tassel; Yudakhin exact formula ычкыры түпөк, кырк муун. Printed төрт (four) retained, not silently changed to dictionary forty. https://el-sozduk.kg/түпөк/. Not a blowpipe.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l037: Алтымыш асый uses horse-maturity count, beginning at five years as first асый. Preserve epic sixty without turning into rider age or asserting exact modern age.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l038: Азуусу horse cheek teeth/molars, not tusks; epic immunity to age preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l039: Epic суп cloth; fine white silk or camel wool dictionary alternatives, fibre not determined. https://el-sozduk.kg/суп/. Bulletproof is narrator’s supernatural claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l040: Канчык female-dog epithet preserved without euphemistic fierce woman. Narrator’s loaded wording, not translator endorsement.
notes.manas-2010:p1689:b001:l010: Колдоюп from колдой- stiffen/be ungainly, not колдо- support. Provisional stance sense beside cock simile. https://el-sozduk.kg/колдой/ Yudakhin/1969/2015.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l018: Келбото epic outer garment, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/келбото/. Not the unrelated clay күлбото; no material/armor construction invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l031: Азирет as epic epithet of Ali, established project lexicon/Yudakhin; narrator’s hyperbolic untouchability formula, not historical military claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l022: Printed бардеги retained in raw. Qualified variant/emendation to баргеги: exact Yudakhin аманат жандын баргеги - ойногондо очогор weapon as delight/support of life. Handicraft reference also records бардек variant. https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?word=баргек. Not destroyer; no independent manuscript collation.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l001: Continues Almambet under attack from previous page; leaning while running retained literally; manner uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l003: Feedbag-shaped head simile retained without making this an actual bag.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l012: Kongurbay explicitly presses in; subsequent Chinese-draining subject returns to Almambet18. No attribution of Almambet’s attacks to Kongurbay.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l013: Ay Zhang-Zhung named separately from Kün Zhang-Zhung1677:13; preserve distinction.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l019: Boot-leg worthlessness idiom; exceptional Kojozhash20 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l022: Cowlike haunches is Sarala’s fixed horse epithet; lean added from established куймулчак description, not a different horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l024: Dragon and secret shooting lore mythic narration, not transformed into historical instruction.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l035: Kara-Kytay and Manzhuu collectives here; no individual sorcerer Manzhuu supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1676:b001:l040: Those gone are forty companions41, not the innumerable Chinese39.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l001: Кынап provisionally precisely/tightly wielding the lance and Zulpuqor from1676:42; no extra weapon action invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l004: Iron net may be martial enclosure metaphor; retain literal image without deciding fortification mechanism.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l011: No regret in death is narrator’s formula; Almambet is not yet slain until1683.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l017: Barrel comparison qualifies size; gray rhinoceros18 retained as exotic mount.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l021: Hungry steel blade and Oykuma26 may designate same blade in this sequence; no new fourth weapon introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l030: Twelve pieces literal hyperbole; not softened into general defeat.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l037: Бейлеп attentively regard/consider; matches correction62:30 and1650:36.
notes.manas-2010:p1677:b001:l040: Trench and boiling misery figurative images kept, no actual burial asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1678:b001:l004: Умачтай ачты уйкумду widely awake; no food imagery imposed as primary meaning.
notes.manas-2010:p1678:b001:l019: Мент кылып rendered trickery provisionally from battle-stratagem context; exact archaic formation needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p1678:b001:l022: Six thousand Chinese and innumerable governors here;35 reverses six thousand governors and innumerable Chinese. Both preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1678:b001:l028: Khan of monks is enemy title; no contemporary religious factual assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1678:b001:l032: Калча fierce epithet of Kongurbay; not another personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1678:b001:l038: Bow-drawing spearmen is printed combination, not homogenized into archers alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1679:b001:l004: Sixty days/sixty wounds then seventy days/seventy wounds retained as separate escalating formulae.
notes.manas-2010:p1679:b001:l015: Жаңжуулап battle cry associated with generals; exact shouted name expanded provisionally as Zhang-Zhung.
notes.manas-2010:p1679:b001:l024: Он эчесин printed variant probably он эченин; ten or more contextual numerical phrase, no precise casualty census.
notes.manas-2010:p1679:b001:l031: Mottled-gray banner literal reading; image may imply confused rout, retained rather than supplying unstated flag owner.
notes.manas-2010:p1680:b001:l018: Gray filly is Kojozhash’s horse; not Sarala.
notes.manas-2010:p1680:b001:l026: Kojozhash unseen26–28; not Almambet magically invisible.
notes.manas-2010:p1680:b001:l038: Louse/thumb infancy similes of companions retained despite Almambet’s separate childhood elsewhere; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1681:b001:l002: Akzholtoy auspicious epithet of Syrgak here, not two people.
notes.manas-2010:p1681:b001:l009: True prophet/faith is narrator’s religious claim preserved as poetry.
notes.manas-2010:p1681:b001:l028: Ezkara included among slain forty thousand29; no historical count asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1681:b001:l039: This passage exempts both Kojozhash and Kongurbay from contempt, whereas1676:20 exempts Kojozhash alone. Variation retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l003: Fleet-Footed and Dagger-Hands named combatant groups, consistent with preceding hand-trained fighters1489.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l006: Printed Karazhoy, although Kojozhash elsewhere called his son; no silent name correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l018: Gathered wealth is provisional literal жыйган; parallel prayer asks faith in death19. Not emended to жыргал.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l027: Manzhuu here identifies Kongurbay as ethnic/title descriptor, not sorcerer personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l032: Аласасы келген destined due/death approaching, horse stumbles next. Not medical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1682:b001:l037: Golden shield worn upon head falls; preserve shield wording without silently replacing helmet.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l003: Almambet attempting to replace fallen head shield before shot. Source sequence preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l009: Shattered head explicit; no censorship or additional gore.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l020: Horse saddle/saddlecloth remain; no rider resurrected after10/17.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l022: Horse hip wound and three-legged flight; not human wound.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l028: Foal-left-behind simile does not establish Sarala as mare; preserve simile against elsewhere male epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p1683:b001:l038: Mountain/refuge lament: goose-circling cliff38 and Almambet mountain42 preserved as separate verses.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l003: Six swift horses preserved; source does not explicitly count six messengers.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l006: Yraman’s Singer Son is traditional named companion Yrchy Uul, translated epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l018: Twelve lost companions here, not reconciled with later corpse counts.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l022: Pursuit to Mecca is Chinese threat quoted by messenger, not narrator’s completed event.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l027: Ыстам understood Islam/Muslim in repeated narrative context; raw variant unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1684:b001:l035: Everyone who meets Beijing dies is rhetorical absolute despite surviving messengers; retain.
notes.manas-2010:p1685:b001:l003: Letter attributed to now-dead Almambet. No invented delivery chronology to reconcile posthumous wording.
notes.manas-2010:p1685:b001:l008: Birth-blood in Beijing is homeland expression, not requiring literal birthplace city modern boundary.
notes.manas-2010:p1685:b001:l026: Ribs tearing could allude bodily wound and grief; felt preserves grief context without claiming healed wound.
notes.manas-2010:p1685:b001:l031: Sock-thick hair tufts retain supernatural anger image.
notes.manas-2010:p1685:b001:l038: Manas grinds teeth into pieces; source extreme literal image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1685:b001:l039: Twin lambs metaphor for companions, not assertion biological twins.
notes.manas-2010:p1686:b001:l004: Death wish bound into oath ending17; no standalone command to reader.
notes.manas-2010:p1686:b001:l023: Stone-wearing Chinese are officials with rank-buttons; established correction, not stone worship.
notes.manas-2010:p1686:b001:l028: Slavery until Judgment Day is character’s violent oath; no endorsement.
notes.manas-2010:p1686:b001:l039: Өзүм жалгыз provisionally only son in conscription excuses; could more broadly mean alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1686:b001:l042: Father’s grave curse retains literal expression.
notes.manas-2010:p1687:b001:l001: Manas’s slaughter/eating threats retained literally as speech; no practical procedure.
notes.manas-2010:p1687:b001:l014: Tracing every yellow trail idiom rendered following every trace, not placing literal grass.
notes.manas-2010:p1687:b001:l034: Retrospective Kokand/Bukhara campaign begins here through1688; no new current journey.
notes.manas-2010:p1687:b001:l036: Mungchu personal name retained; no identification with current politician/historical person.
notes.manas-2010:p1687:b001:l042: Six thousand ingots/thousand otter pelts tribute, continued1688:1–3; no currency conversion. Lexical correction2026-09-14: кундуз animal/fur means otter, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кундуз/51–54 including exact collar-endearment formula;1969/2015 aquatic carnivorous mammal supports. Earlier beaver reading corrected; raw/SHA/bbox unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l008: Narrator contrasts ignorant booty account with informed heavenly origin; both kept, not editorial apparatus.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l015: Forty chiltens hidden saints/protective spirits, not living forty companions interchangeably.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l024: Khojosan spiritual protector name; position beneath arm literal apparition image.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l026: Black-spotted lion supernatural protector; natural lion coat not corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p1688:b001:l034: Sieve lungs/copper wings epic horse physiology retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1689:b001:l007: Straight inward direction relative to stronghold unresolved; no destination invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1689:b001:l022: Horse beneath him though previously led8; narrative shift retained, not added mounting verse.
notes.manas-2010:p1689:b001:l025: Жебенин огу literally arrow’s projectile amid gunfire. Neutral projectile retains weapon ambiguity; no switch mechanically asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1689:b001:l027: Ооз омуртка first neck vertebra; anatomical term retained, not mouth bone.
notes.manas-2010:p1689:b001:l042: Кутпа north per edition glossary/project lexicon, not qibla.
notes.manas-2010:p1690:b001:l006: Bites his own thumb in grief; no generic lip biting substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1690:b001:l009: Manas slaughters fallen Akkula; prior collapse not assumed independently final death.
notes.manas-2010:p1690:b001:l015: Ear and forelock explicit keepsakes; no shortening to mane only.
notes.manas-2010:p1690:b001:l026: Almambet martyr wording narrator belief; no external religious judgment.
notes.manas-2010:p1690:b001:l032: Taking girls as plunder explicit; not softened into treasure only.
notes.manas-2010:p1690:b001:l034: Devouring own champions is grief/self-blame metaphor, retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l001: Сары оору wasting illness idiom rather than unsupported diagnosis of jaundice.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l008: Zhang-Zhung could title/governor-general collective; conventional spelling retained, individual identity unconfirmed.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l016: Eighteen thousand worlds conventional cosmic total, not empirical count.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l030: Аты уйкаш matching names formula retained even though Almambet/Chubak not obvious rhyme; no matched horses substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l039: Арга жүгүн burden of endurance/recourse provisional, not specified weight or object.
notes.manas-2010:p1691:b001:l042: Кыясы кымбат cliffs difficult/costly to traverse contextual reading; no financial valuation.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l001: Red horse hypothetical ride, no newly acquired mount asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l007: Young son left behind is Semetey by established narrative; name not added to verse.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l015: Twelve ages hyperbole and incomplete transition retained, no omitted clause silently supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l017: Укурук кайрар restraint by herding pole image rendered rein him in; subject no one provisionally inferred from калды negative.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l020: Weapon shoulder mirror image retained; not literal mirror attached.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l024: Birth recollection places fortune in Altay; not later return journey.
notes.manas-2010:p1692:b001:l036: Sacred steel bullet gift one only; magical narrative not modern weapon guidance.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l003: Birth mouth-touch ritual; object inferred gifted bullet and agent holy man, syntax compressed and needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l007: Akolpok named coat with bullet sewn collar; not metal cuirass.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l015: Half charge printed жарым дары; no mass, ratio, modern specification or procedural expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l017: Күпсөр powder container contextual use, not independently asserted capacity.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l020: Spyglass/telescope turned seven then ten times and bound to gun32; preserve fantastic mechanism without modern optics explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l023: Seven rope lengths then ten27 retained without physical-length conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1693:b001:l037: Gun rested on rock; subject/object supplied from34–36, not rock placed on gun.
notes.manas-2010:p1694:b001:l005: Ninety Beijings epic total, not city census.
notes.manas-2010:p1694:b001:l014: Chynchy Khan name/title combination provisionally kept. Exact identity and relation to earlier Chynchuu unknown; source clear кан term.
notes.manas-2010:p1694:b001:l021: Burut Kyrgyz exonym in enemy speech retained, not new people identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1694:b001:l027: Black felt cap brim synecdoche for Syrgak, consistent with cap descriptions; not Karakalpak ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1694:b001:l033: Twelve of forty repeated explicitly; not whole forty dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l005: Üpü named medicine only; no botanical/drug identification or modern treatment claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l011: Шуркут wanton/sexually available women in enemy speech; derogatory narrator vocabulary preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l013: Амыз = shame/namys variant per prior dictionary review. Enemy plans forcible breeding, translated without endorsement or erotic detail.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l019: Excelling son conditional19–20; birth not yet actual.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l022: Karykhan personal name left without speculative linkage to earlier rulers.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l026: Бирдигин unity rendered literally as authority over united realm, relation to бийлик possible but no emendation made.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l033: One flask of liquor, exact strength/unit not established.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l037: Айдарым exposed windblown place contextual reading, not person name asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1695:b001:l042: Shout continues next page; no manufactured ending.
